pages.title: You've Completed the Onboarding Tour
pages.text:
Congratulations! You have completed the steakOS onboarding tour.

You understand the journey from concepts to daily use: templates (Bronze → Gold), AI helpers, Bitcoin, Nostr, and the APQC process map.

**Next step:** run the configuration wizard in the app. It asks a few simple questions, creates your company setup, and turns on the Bronze team desks.

Use the buttons below — no separate training server needed.
examples: Continue to the setup wizard in this browser
Or open the dashboard if you already finished setup
